import CategoryTheory.Functor
import CategoryTheory.NatIso
import Data.Finset
import Data.Nat

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {C : Type u₁} [CategoryTheory.Category.{u₂, u₁} C] (F : CategoryTheory.Functor C FintypeCat) {X Y : C} (i : X ≅ Y) : Nat.card (F.obj X).obj = Nat.card (F.obj Y).obj := by
  let σ : F.obj X ≅ F.obj Y := NatIso.ofComponents.app F F (λ _ => id) (λ _ _ => rfl) i.is_iso
  let f := σ.hom
  let g := σ.inv
  have hf : Function.Bijective f := by intros x y; exact Eq.symm (Function.injective_iff_surjective (Function.bijective_iff_left_inverse f g))
  have hg : Function.Bijective g := by intros x y; exact Eq.symm (Function.injective_iff_surjective (Function.bijective_iff_left_inverse g f))
  exact Nat.subtype_card f (Finset.card_eq_of_bijection f g)
